statements.impact_statement: russh 0.64.1 (1.0.4) is listed only because the image ships the tag Cargo.lock at /usr/share/doc/rustfs/Cargo.lock (the prebuilt binary has no cargo-auditable section); the crate is not compiled into /usr/bin/rustfs. russh is optional in the rustfs-protocols crate and enabled only by the sftp feature (tag 1.0.4 commit 46337942d55f3a8e6a97b147ca98d9ea8115555d: crates/protocols/Cargo.toml:179 russh = { workspace = true, optional = true }, crates/protocols/Cargo.toml:109 sftp = [dep:russh, ...]; rustfs/Cargo.toml:60 default = [ftps, webdav, gcs], rustfs/Cargo.toml:66 the only route to rustfs-protocols/sftp). The other russh user, e2e_test, is a test crate outside the release build. Verified 2026-11-01: grep -aoE over the sha256-pinned musl binaries found 383 (1.0.4 x86_64), 379 (1.0.4 aarch64) registry/src crate-version paths and 0 matching russh or pageant, so the russh SSH agent server confirm-constraint handling code is not present. The recipe fails the build if any russh crate path appears in the binary or if the binary stops carrying crate paths.
